description: A scene the reader touches: scratch a foil away to reveal a number, drag a divider across a before-and-after pair, or press and hold to fill a value up to its number. For the one number or turn the reader should feel, not just read.

after_label.description: Wipe only: what the after value is: "Today's total". Required when kind is wipe.

after_value.description: Wipe only: the after value, as the article states it. Required when kind is wipe.

before_label.description: Wipe only: what the before value is: "Old record". Required when kind is wipe.

before_value.description: Wipe only: the before value, as the article states it. Required when kind is wipe.

fill_seconds.description: Hold only: how long a full hold takes, in seconds. The fill rate is the target divided by this, so a bigger number fills faster in absolute units. Default 3. Use 1.5-2 for a fast-moving number (a crash, a surge: it should feel urgent) and about 4 for a slow one. This is a timing choice, not a fact from the article, so the checker does not verify it.

from_value.description: Hold only, optional: the article number the change is measured from. When present with to_value, the fill counts the change between the two numbers (for example the dollars lost from a peak to where the price is now), computed by the page from these two article numbers, so the storyboard holds only numbers the article states. When absent, the fill counts from zero up to to_value.

kind.description: Which interaction this scene is: scratch a foil, wipe across a before and after, or press and hold to fill a value.

label.description: What the interaction is about, in a few words: "Nvidia share price".

to_value.description: Hold only: the value the fill counts up to, or, when from_value is present, the value the change is measured to. An article number either way.

unit.description: Wipe and hold only: the unit shown with the values: "$" or " mm". Required when kind is wipe or hold.

unit_after.description: Wipe and hold only: true when the unit goes after the number ("84 mm"), false when it goes before ("$243.37"). Leave it out for before.

value.description: Scratch only: the hidden number, as the article writes it: "32%". Required when kind is scratch.

title: Reactive
